design.decision: Keep trumps and dangerous honors for the endgame, knowing you can cash or shed them freely in the last four tricks.
design.opponent: Revealed the first time it allows an off-suit play; opponents can no longer count on end-of-round squeezes.
design.rationale: Near-duplicate of seed-any-suit by amount; the three-trick rare measured -8.1 against its control, so its power fits common, and a wider window gives more endgame choices.
design.draftText: Your team can play any suit on the last four tricks

critic.concerns: Amount-only near-duplicate of seed-any-suit, with a rarity move.
